items.title: Capital Group Div Value (CGDV) Buys $69.5 Million More FTAI Aviation on Nov. 6
items.summary: The fund bought $69.5 million of FTAI Aviation and $65.7 million of Meta Platforms, while selling $18.5 million of Exxon Mobil.

items.title: Review & Preview: Dip Buyers Unite
items.summary: Indexes popped as investors bought the dip, fueling a rebound rally on Wall Street.

items.title: Seagate Soars 10% in AI Rebound as Morgan Stanley Sees “Strong Fundamentals and Weak Sentiment”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSeagate shares jumped 10% today as AI hardware stocks, including Coherent, bounced back from last week’s selloff. Morgan Stanley kept Seagate as a top pick with a $1,148 price target, citing its strong fundamentals and weak sentiment.

items.title: Micron Rises 6% as Bulls Tout Its Bargain Valuation and Buyback Firepower; Seagate and Western Digital Jump 11%
items.summary: Micron trades at a single-digit earnings multiple while sitting on a huge buyback authorization, yet the hard drive makers are rallying even harder. Is the memory giant a bargain, or is a cheap multiple warning that peak earnings are near?

items.title: Is Western Digital Emerging as a Big Winner in the AI Storage Boom?
items.summary: WDC is capitalizing on AI-driven storage demand, with surging cloud revenue, higher-capacity HDD adoption and strong fiscal 2027 growth prospects.

items.title: STX Posts Record Q1 FY27 Profit: Can AI Storage Demand Drive Growth?
items.summary: Seagate's shares have surged 56.8% over the past year, while rising earnings estimates for fiscal 2027 and 2028 add to its investment appeal.

items.title: Seagate (STX) Stock Could Be Undervalued As Its Three Year Run Continues
items.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings has experienced significant volatility in recent years, which puts a spotlight on a basic question for anyone looking at the stock today. With earnings under scrutiny after sharp sector swings and changing data center expectations, the issue is whether the current valuation still lines up with what the business is actually earning. Over the past 3 years the share price has delivered a very large gain, which puts a lot of past optimism about Seagate's profit power...

items.title: Marvell and Western Digital Just Had Their Worst Week Since 2001
items.summary: Both chipmakers raised guidance, yet investors dumped them like a crisis was underway. One election, one record-setting selloff, and one looming merger now separate a sturdier bet from a riskier one.
